summary: Frontend-only validation of Login inline-error fix on /login. All critical scenarios PASS: empty submit shows all 3 inline errors (error-role, error-email, error-password) with rose field borders; partial fill (no role) shows only error-role and stays on /login; admin/security/student credentials successfully authenticate and navigate to dashboard-page with correct role-scoped sidebar items; demo quick-fill (demo-student) prefills email/password and highlights the role tile; invalid credentials render error-submit rose alert ('Invalid credentials') and user remains on /login; role-mismatch (student role tile + admin creds) still logs in and navigates. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx: role-mismatch shows a sonner toast.warning but there is no persistent/visible indicator on the dashboard; if product wants users to notice mismatch, consider surfacing as a banner instead of a transient toast.
AuthContext localStorage token: consider migrating to httpOnly cookie per playbook (currently token in localStorage is XSS-exposed) — not in scope for this fix but worth noting.
Demo quick-fill triggers a toast even when clicked repeatedly with same role — minor UX polish.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inline validation + all 3 role logins verified end-to-end via Playwright against public URL. data-testid coverage on Login page is complete (login-form, login-email, login-password, login-submit, role-*, demo-*, error-role, error-email, error-password, error-submit). Sidebar assertions used page.content() substring matching; note: student's dashboard content contains the substring 'Inventory' inside dashboard cards even though sidebar does not — this was a false-positive in the string check, not a real bug. For future sidebar tests, scope the query to the <aside>/nav element.
